_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — declares the 'General' app-settings entry. It is NOT a normal menu group: menu-layout.json#settingsSection lists its id, so applySettingsSection in main.js lifts it (and all config/master-data pages) into Nextcloud's settings foldout (the bottom-left gear, NcAppNavigationSettings, OUTSIDE the scrollable nav). 'Personal settings' is auto-prepended by CnAppNav.
_meta.description: The 'General' app-settings entry for the Nextcloud settings foldout (see menu-layout.json#settingsSection). ADR-079 D1: it hands off to the platform admin section at /settings/admin/shillinq (AdminSettings.php → AdminRoot.vue) instead of routing to an in-app type:settings page, which was a second home for the same register configuration.
